name: Pip: Offline Install
description: Install a requirements file from a local wheelhouse with no internet. Verifies checksums, can create the virtual environment, and runs pip check afterwards.

parameters.name: wheelhouse
parameters.label: Wheelhouse folder
parameters.help: The folder made by 'Pip: Download Wheelhouse' (unzipped).

parameters.name: venv
parameters.label: Virtual environment
parameters.help: Created if it does not exist. Leave empty to install into the Python that runs this script.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.label: Dry run (check only)
parameters.help: Checks that everything is available without installing it.
